repo_notes.content: The real source layout is src/{loaders,ingestion,stores,pipeline,types}. Earlier steering named src/embeddings/, src/vectordb/, src/retrieval/, src/chunking/ and src/indexing/ — none of those directories exist.
repo_notes.author: rei-doc-specialist

repo_notes.content: docs/ already holds API, DOCUMENT_LOADERS, EMBEDDINGS, PIPELINES and VECTOR_STORES; the wiki should agree with them rather than restate them.
